name: Should multigenerational homes include home offices?

mainEntity.name: Should multigenerational homes include home offices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, private suite offices plus shared workspaces accommodate remote work, homeschooling, and hobbies while maintaining separation from family living areas.
